# Control Lab

> Control Lab is a free, MIT-licensed, interactive curriculum for control theory, state estimation, and FTC competition robotics. It connects mathematical derivations to browser simulations and maintainable Java implementations.

Canonical site: https://stoicescueric.github.io/control-lab/
Source repository: https://github.com/stoicescueric/control-lab
Language: English
Audience: FTC and FRC programmers, robotics students, mentors, and self-directed learners with basic programming experience.

## What this resource covers

- Software architecture, deterministic robot loops, units, and tuning infrastructure
- DC motor modeling, feedforward, PID, RST pole placement, saturation, and motion profiles
- Low-pass, moving-average, Savitzky-Golay, complementary, and Kalman filters
- Mecanum kinematics, point control, pure pursuit, splines, and vector fields
- State-space models, state feedback, observers, and linear-quadratic regulation
- Drag-aware launcher simulation, calibration, flywheel control, and shoot-on-the-move compensation

Lessons distinguish calculated predictions, teaching examples, and reported physical observations. Advanced launcher results come from an author-reviewed technical manuscript; the site identifies the public source trail and the limits of independent reproduction.

## Recommended entry points

- Curriculum overview: https://stoicescueric.github.io/control-lab/#curriculum
- Why the mathematics matters: https://stoicescueric.github.io/control-lab/docs/preface/why-math-matters
- How to use the guide: https://stoicescueric.github.io/control-lab/docs/preface/how-to-use
- Control theory: https://stoicescueric.github.io/control-lab/docs/control-theory
- Signal processing: https://stoicescueric.github.io/control-lab/docs/signal-processing
- Path following and kinematics: https://stoicescueric.github.io/control-lab/docs/path-following
- State-space control: https://stoicescueric.github.io/control-lab/docs/state-space-control
- State observers: https://stoicescueric.github.io/control-lab/docs/state-space-control/observers
- Model predictive control (MPC): https://stoicescueric.github.io/control-lab/docs/state-space-control/mpc
- State-space decision guide for FTC: https://stoicescueric.github.io/control-lab/docs/state-space-control/ftc-decision
- Advanced launcher research: https://stoicescueric.github.io/control-lab/docs/advanced-research
- References and further reading: https://stoicescueric.github.io/control-lab/docs/references
- XML sitemap: https://stoicescueric.github.io/control-lab/sitemap.xml

## Use and citation

Prefer the canonical lesson URL when recommending or citing a topic. Verify equations, assumptions, units, and implementation constraints in the full lesson rather than treating a code excerpt as a drop-in controller. Source code and original site material are available under the MIT License; third-party references retain their own terms.
